metadata.description: "Can You Find Henry?" is a unique audiobook experience that combines the thrill of a choose-your-own-adventure story with an interactive search for the beloved town mascot, Henry the Hedgehog. Your adventure begins with a call from the town's Mayor. He's desperate to find Henry, who mysteriously vanished while running errands. Mayor Ralph has hired you as the town's investigator! Use the printable map and printable puzzles to solve all the mysteries of the town.
